premise: Lola and Dog's picnic is rained on; they squeeze under the umbrella, Dog dashes out and comes back to shake all over Lola, and a rainbow makes it all worthwhile.
inspiration: The weathered-picnic of nursery stories, played for laughs: the rain is a game, the wet dog the joke, the rainbow the reward.
lesson: A spoiled plan can turn into the best part.

en-US.title: The Rainy Picnic
en-US.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola and {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog were having a picnic on the sand. {girl:face happy} {dog:hop} Then… plip. Plop. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter! Rain! {girl:face surprised} {umbrella:enter} {girl:says} [excited] "Quick, Dog! Under the umbrella!" {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} They squeezed in under the big red-and-white umbrella. {umbrella:pulse} Tap, tap, tap went the rain on top. {girl:face happy} Cosy! But Dog couldn't sit still. {dog:go to girl right} Out he dashed into the rain, {dog:face happy} round and round. Then back he came, {dog:go under umbrella} dripping wet, {dog:live} and SHOOK, right next to Lola. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] "Dog! Now I'm wetter than the rain!" [short pause] Then the rain stopped. {umbrella:live} The umbrella gave a little spin, flicking off the last drops. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] And there, over the bay, was a rainbow. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] "Worth getting wet for." {dog:hearts}

es-ES.title: El picnic con lluvia
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola y {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Perro estaban de picnic en la arena. {girl:face happy} {dog:hop} Entonces… plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.8 18s} {sfx:rain} ¡Tip-tap! ¡Lluvia! {girl:face surprised} {umbrella:enter} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Rápido, Perro! ¡Debajo de la sombrilla!» {girl:go under umbrella} {dog:go under umbrella} Se apretujaron bajo la gran sombrilla roja y blanca. {umbrella:pulse} Tac, tac, tac, hacía la lluvia encima. {girl:face happy} ¡Qué a gustito! Pero Perro no podía estarse quieto. {dog:go to girl right} Salió corriendo bajo la lluvia, {dog:face happy} vueltas y más vueltas. Luego volvió, {dog:go under umbrella} chorreando, {dog:live} y se SACUDIÓ justo al lado de Lola. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Perro! ¡Ahora estoy más mojada que la lluvia!» [short pause] Luego dejó de llover. {umbrella:live} La sombrilla dio una vueltecita, sacudiéndose las últimas gotas. {canvas:rainbow 14s} [gasps] Y allí, sobre la bahía, apareció un arcoíris. {girl:face happy} {dog:face happy} {girl:says} [softly] «Ha merecido la pena mojarse.» {dog:hearts}
